user_intent.original_question: 找出每个类型（genre）中评分最高的电影，显示类型名、电影标题和评分

metrics.name: 最高评分
metrics.formula: MAX(t.average_rating) 或 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY genre ORDER BY average_rating DESC)

business_rules.name: 评分可信度
business_rules.condition: 排名类查询应加 num_votes > 10000 过滤

business_rules.name: genre_id 是字符串
business_rules.condition: genres.id 存的是字符串如 'action', 'comedy'，非数字

historical_qa_pairs.original_question: 各类型电影平均评分（含热度指数）
historical_qa_pairs.sql: SELECT g.display_name AS genre, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS movie_count, ROUND(AVG(t.average_rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM titles t JOIN titles_genres tg ON tg.title_id = t.id JOIN genres g ON g.id = tg.genre_id WHERE t.title_type = 'movie' AND t.num_votes > 5000 AND t.start_year >= 2000 AND t.start_year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.id, g.display_name ORDER BY avg_rating DESC

WITH ranked AS (SELECT primary_title, start_year, average_rating, num_votes, FLOOR(start_year / 10) * 10 AS decade, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FLOOR(start_year / 10) * 10 ORDER BY average_rating DESC) AS rn FROM titles WHERE title_type = 'movie' AND num_votes > 50000 AND start_year IS NOT NULL) SELECT decade AS decade_range, primary_title, start_year, average_rating, num_votes FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY decade_range DESC

knowledge.content: titles ←→ titles_genres ←→ genres，通过 titles_genres.title_id = titles.id 和 titles_genres.genre_id = genres.id 关联
titles.average_rating 为 IMDb 加权平均分(1.0-10.0)，titles.num_votes 为投票总数，titles.primary_title 为主要标题
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY genre ORDER BY average_rating DESC) 可用于找出每组最高评分电影
